title: Home Safe, Bank Vault, or Third-Party Storage: Where to Keep Your Silver
description: Your silver storage choice affects cost, access, and security in different ways. Here is what home safes, safe deposit boxes, and third-party vaults each offer and when each one makes sense.
alt: Three storage option cards showing home safe, bank safe deposit box at $75 per year, and third-party vault at $20 per month with security and access comparison
